name: CodeIXE Site Watermark
author: codeixe

sections.description:
CodeIXE Site Watermark adds a non-intrusive watermark overlay to the front end of your WordPress site. Upload your logo, type your own text, pick a style and decide exactly where it appears.

Features

  • Text watermark, logo watermark, or both together
  • Three styles: Transparent, Normal and Bold, plus an optional custom opacity
  • Positions: center, any corner, or tiled across the whole page
  • Control size, color and rotation
  • Show it on the entire site, only on selected pages, or everywhere except selected pages
  • Target the homepage, archives/search/404 pages, whole post types (pages, posts, products and more), specific pages, or specific IDs
  • Optionally hide it for logged-in administrators or on mobile screens
  • The overlay never blocks clicks, links or buttons
  • Works with page caching plugins, because visibility is decided per URL

Developed by CodeIXE AI Solutions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codeixe-site-watermark folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Settings > Site Watermark.
  4. Choose your text and/or logo, set the style and display options, tick “Enable watermark” and save.
sections.faq:
How do I show the watermark on only some pages?

Under “Where to display”, choose “Only on the pages selected below”, then tick the homepage, post types, specific pages, or enter post IDs.

How do I show it everywhere except a few pages?

Choose “Everywhere EXCEPT the pages selected below” and select the pages to exclude.

Can I use my own logo?

Yes. Click “Upload / Select logo” and choose an image from the Media Library. A transparent PNG or SVG works best.

Does the watermark protect my images from being copied?

No. It is a visual overlay for branding. Anyone with browser developer tools can hide it, so it is not a copy-protection tool.

Does the plugin collect data or contact external services?

No. It stores its settings in your WordPress database and makes no external requests.
